definitions.explanation: A vivid fantasy or dreamlike state experienced while awake. A literary or psychological term; in conversation people more often say {空想|くうそう} or ぼんやり{考|かんが}える.

examples.japanese: {白昼夢|はくちゅうむ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧。
⟦まるで→まるで：03739_marude⟧{白昼夢|はくちゅうむ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ような⟦{出来事|できごと}→出来事：03446_dekigoto⟧だった。
examples.english: It was like something out of a daydream.

examples.japanese: ⟦{授業中|じゅぎょうちゅう}→授業中：20544_jugyouchuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{白昼夢|はくちゅうむ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ふけって→ふける：09960_fukeru⟧⟦いて→いる：00495_iru⟧、⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{呼|よ}ばれて→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{気|き}づかなかった。
examples.english: I was lost in a daydream during class and didn't notice when the teacher called my name.

notes:
⟦{白昼|はくちゅう}→白昼：23777_hakuchuu⟧ (broad daylight) + ⟦{夢|ゆめ}→夢：01519_yume⟧ (dream).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {白昼夢|はくちゅうむ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧: to have a daydream
- {白昼夢|はくちゅうむ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ふける→ふける：09960_fukeru⟧: to be lost in a daydream

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{空想|くうそう}→空想：00256_kuusou⟧: fantasy, imagination — the everyday word
- ⟦{妄想|もうそう}→妄想：06813_mousou⟧: delusion; wild fantasy
- ⟦{夢|ゆめ}→夢：01519_yume⟧: dream (while asleep); hope
